# Independent SGP4 verification data

Source: https://celestrak.org/publications/AIAA/2006-6753/AIAA-2006-6753.zip
Downloaded 2026-09-24. Original paths: sgp4/cpp/testsgp4/SGP4-VER.TLE and
sgp4/for/tforverf.out (renamed reference.txt). Values are TEME km and km/s.
See DEC-0112; these are independent expected results, not generated by our core.

The supplied artificial error case 33334 must fail propagation. Its FORTRAN
output retains satellite 33333's last position; that line is not a valid orbit.
The test checks rejection rather than comparing against those stale numbers.
